enchantment.iridescent_reforging.mana_bo: Increases maximum mana by +4 per level while held.
enchantment.iridescent_reforging.mana_re: Increases mana regeneration by +3%% per level while held.
enchantment.iridescent_reforging.arcane_: Increases spell power by +4%% per level while held.
enchantment.iridescent_reforging.vorpal_: Spell crits gain +3%% crit chance and +5%% crit damage per level, with a 5%% chance per level to decapitate on a critical hit.
enchantment.iridescent_reforging.spell_e: On cast, 5%% chance per level for the spell to cost no mana, on a short internal cooldown.
enchantment.iridescent_reforging.mana_si: On spell hit, returns 5%% of the spell damage dealt as mana per level (capped per second).
enchantment.iridescent_reforging.resonan: Increases the duration of beneficial potion effects you gain by +50%% per level while held.
